leads.title: Vermont birth certificate and driver's license gender marker laws - Vermont General Assembly / Governor Phil Scott / Department of Motor Vehicles / Department of Health
leads.documents: Permits change of gender marker to male, female or X based on self-determination without court order, diagnosis, surgery or medical permission; DMV X option with no documentation
